Step 3. By the measurable spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the measurable spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Fourier interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
